steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing the HTML to APK Converter Studio app name and package configuration.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build System
steps.description: Create app/build.gradle setting target SDK to 34, minimum SDK to 21, and configuring Java 8 compatibility with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate permissions (INTERNET) and MainActivity configuration using standard system icons.

steps.title: Design Color Palette
steps.description: Define deep professional blues, slate grays, and glowing cyan accents in colors.xml for a clean development workspace aesthetic.

steps.title: Define Custom UI Styles
steps.description: Create styles.xml using native Material.Light theme configurations without androidx or external library dependencies.

steps.title: Design Drawable Backgrounds
steps.description: Create shape drawables for custom editor styling, button rounded surfaces, and dynamic tab selections.

steps.title: Design Application Layout
steps.description: Develop dynamic split view holding the Code Editor, active quick tags block, responsive WebView renderer, and export configurations guide.

steps.title: Develop Main Activity - Code Setup
steps.description: Initialize main activity entrypoint, register controls, and construct basic custom screen states switcher.

steps.title: Develop Code Editor Snippets Feature
steps.description: Create programmatically populated snippet tags bar inside editor panel for seamless mobile HTML scripting.

steps.title: Develop Templates Loader System
steps.description: Design an fully native list view adapter managing 4 interactive, responsive self-contained preloaded template files.

steps.title: Configure Sandbox WebView Renderer
steps.description: Enable V8 features, DOM storage capabilities, and client callbacks to run sandbox outputs on CARTO server framework.

steps.title: Develop Exporter Manual Guide
steps.description: Implement fully readable comprehensive instructional guide inside the app outlining standard Android Studio web asset directory setup steps.

steps.title: Building HTML to APK Converter Studio
steps.description: Assemble and compile the complete clean project matching SDK 34 specifications in standard headless environment.
